title: BRP Recalls Can-Am Side-By-Side Vehicles Due to Loss of Steering Control Hazard
summary: Improper assembly of the steering column to the rack and pinion can result in the loss of steering control, posing a risk of serious injury or death to the user, passenger or bystanders. Units: About 3,400.

title: High-Pressure Scuba Diving Air Hoses Recalled by A-Plus Marine Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The diving hose that connects the regulator to the tank's pressure gauge can separate reducing the available air supply to the diver, posing a drowning hazard. Units: About 40.

title: John Deere Recalls Gator Utility Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel line can separate, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 4,650.

title: Columbia Sportswear Reannounces Its Recall of Batteries Sold With Jackets Due To Fire Hazard
summary: The batteries have a cell defect which can cause overheating, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 66 batteries (33 jackets with two battery packs each).

title: Polaris Recalls Ranger Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Loss of Control and Crash Hazard
summary: The recreational vehicle's throttle can fail to operate properly, which can cause the vehicle's rider to lose control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 327.

title: Fisher-Price Recalls to Inspect Rock 'N Play Infant Sleepers Due to Risk of Exposure to Mold
summary: Mold can develop between the removable seat cushion and the hard plastic frame of the sleeper when it remains wet/moist or is infrequently cleaned, posing a risk of exposure to mold to infants sleeping in the product. The CPSC advises that mold has been associated with respiratory illnesses and othe

title: PLATINUM Neon Sign Power Supply Transformers Made by HEICO lighting Recalled Due To Fire Hazard
summary: The transformers do not meet the UL standard for this product and pose a fire risk. Units: About 3,900.

title: Goodman Company Recalls Amana Heating and Cooling Units Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The serial plates on the units have inaccurate information that could result in installers and servicers using undersized wiring, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 155.

title: Academy Sports + Outdoors Recalls Crossbow Cocking Ropes Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The hooks attaching the cocking rope to the crossbow string can break and cause it to recoil, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 6,300.

title: Brower Recalls Top Hatch Egg Incubators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The base can ignite during use, posing a fire hazard to the consumer. Units: About 2,500.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The steerer tube in the front fork can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 12,200.

title: Mattress Cloud Recalls Mattresses Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The mattresses fail to meet the mandatory federal open flame standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,400.

title: Implus Footcare Recalls Perfect Fitness Resistance Bands Due To Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at WalMart
summary: The bands can detach from the mesh cloth loops posing an injury hazard to the user and those in the vicinity. Units: 75600.

title: Siemens Recalls Temperature and Humidity Sensors for Schools, Hospitals and Other Buildings Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The sensors can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 57,000.

title: American Signature Recalls Hayward Push Back Chairs Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Value City Furniture and American Signature Furniture Stores
summary: The chair can tip over backwards when used in its fully reclined position, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,158.

title: Floor Lamps Recalled by Dolan Northwest Due to Shock and Fire Hazards
summary: The on/off foot switch on the lamps can fail and melt, resulting in shock and fire hazards. Units: About 1,100.

title: Powertec Recalls Weight Workbenches Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The weld on the backrest adjustment brackets of the weight workbench can break, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 565.

title: Target Recalls Hand-Held Air Misters Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The Air Mister can shatter during use, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 168,000.

title: Bugaboo Recalls Strollers Due to Fall and Choking Hazards
summary: A button on the stroller's carrycot/seat carry handle can become disengaged and cause the handle to detach, posing fall and choking hazards to young children. Units: About 46,300 in the U.S. and 4,440 in Canada.

title: KTM North America Recalls Enduro Motorcycles Due to Fuel Leak, Fire and Crash Hazard
summary: During use, the pre-formed fuel hose can develop small holes or cracks at the ends of the hose, allowing fuel to leak. This poses a fire and crash hazard to the rider and/or others. Units: About 1,300.

title: Target Recalls Children's Two-Piece Pajama Sets Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The children's cotton or cotton/fleece pajamas sets fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, because they do not meet the tight-fitting sizing requirements. This poses a burn hazard to children. Units: About 560,000.

title: Target Recalls Circo Girls Fleece Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: 42000.

title: FoodState Recalls Bottles of MegaFood One Daily Supplements Due to Lack of Child-Resistant Packaging
summary: The packaging is not child-resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The supplement tablets inside the bottle contain iron, which can cause serious injury or death to young children if multiple tablets are ingested at once. Units: About 7,400 units.

title: High Powered Magnet Balls Recalled by SCS Direct Due to Risk of Ingestion; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: When two or more magnets are swallowed, they can link together inside a child's intestines and clamp onto body tissues, causing intestinal obstructions, perforations, sepsis and death. Internal injury from magnets can pose serious lifelong health effects. Units: About 106,000.

title: Kringles Toys and Gifts Recalls High Powered Magnets Due to Ingestion Hazard; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: If two or more magnets are swallowed, they can link together inside a child's intestines and clamp onto body tissues, causing intestinal obstructions, perforations, sepsis and death. Internal injury from magnets can pose serious lifelong health effects. Units: About 4,200.

title: Triaminic and Theraflu Products Recalled Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: These child-resistant caps can fail to function properly and enable the cap to be removed by a child with the tamper-evident seal in place, posing a risk of unintentional ingestion and poisoning. These products contain acetaminophen and diphenhydramine which are required by the Poison Prevention Pac

title: World Imports Recalls Bunk Beds Due to Violation of Safety Standard
summary: The openings between the metal rails of the end structures are greater than allowed in the standard and pose a risk of entrapment or asphyxiation hazard. Units: About 8,600.

title: Million Dollar Baby Dressers Recalled by Bexco Due to Tip-Over Hazards; Two Toddler Deaths Reported
summary: If a young child climbs up open dresser drawers, the dresser can tip over and pose the risk of entrapment. Units: 18000.

title: Natart Chelsea Dressers Recalled By Gemme Juvenile To Reduce Tip-Over Hazard; Death of Toddler Reported
summary: If a young child climbs up open dresser drawers, the dresser can tip over and pose the risk of entrapment. Units: About 300.

title: Sportspower Expands Trampoline Recall Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Walmart
summary: The enclosure netting surrounding these trampolines can break, allowing children to fall through the netting and be injured. Units: About 120,000 (92,000 units were recalled in May 2012).

title: BRP Recalls Can-Am Side-By-Side Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Debris such as leaves, hay and grass in wet terrain areas can collect in the vehicle's exhaust pipe area in a short period of time. A hot exhaust pipe and accumulated debris that has dried, poses a risk of fire. Units: About 25,000.

title: Columbia Sportswear Recalls Seven Models of Heated Jackets Due To Burn Hazard
summary: The heated inner wrist cuff can overheat, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 9,600 in the U.S. and 640 in Canada.
